question:
Identify the figure given in the options that when put in place of the question mark (?) will logically complete the series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e220b54650b5ab86bfb8f9e8bc4a8b76a22a9eddc489dbca34802e77d992be24.png]
solution:
The image that replaces the question mark (?) in the following series is as shown below:-

 
• The figure rotates in a clockwise direction.
 
• The dark side switches the front and back.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ca0202f7e7597acbe0a3bfcba1531a41469a48a86f6a5c09ed178daf17c91d3.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
